The camera wearer's own dark-sleeved right arm or hand is partially visible at the bottom-right corner in frames 1 and 4, and the tip of their boot appears at the bottom center in frame 2. Across the five frames, the camera wearer advances along the trail at a fairly steady distance behind the first person from frames 1 to 4 before closing the gap in frame 5 to roughly 0.8 to 1.2 metres, shifting the blue-backpacked person into the right half of the view and bringing their backpack nearly within the camera wearer's arm's reach while the two people ahead remain within arm's reach of each other.
